## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change

## Testing

- [ ] `python3 -m pytest` passes
- [ ] Tested end to end on macOS with a real Mail account (if applicable)

Describe the test case or the sample used:

## Checklist

- [ ] The diff is focused; no unrelated reformatting
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test
- [ ] No real email addresses, message IDs, or credentials in the diff
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
